thought: To implement the workflow, I need to define the necessary trigger and actions first. The workflow requires a manual trigger, an AI completion action to generate SQL query, a PostgreSQL action to execute the query, and a Slack action to send the results to a channel.
plan: Define a manual trigger function to start the workflow.
Define an aiCompletion action function to generate SQL query based on system and user prompts.
Define a PostgreSQL executeQuery action function to run the generated SQL query.
Define a Slack message post action function to send the query results to the 'general' channel.
criticism: The plan assumes the available actions are sufficient and the parameters can be properly set. The main challenge will be to format the data correctly between steps, especially cleaning AI output and formatting Slack messages.
